scope: MicroVM external egress policy boundary: preserve default-deny while supporting DNS/FQDN-based Clerk/Claude/optional-GLM connectivity without broad Internet escape

counterhypothesis.claim: A standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy allow rule can safely restore all required external ClayVerse provider connectivity without an additional FQDN-aware or proxy boundary.
counterhypothesis.reason: The required providers are addressed by DNS/FQDN and may resolve to changing IPs. Restoring function through unrestricted HTTPS/DNS or broad public CIDRs would defeat the fail-closed baseline. Standard Kubernetes NetworkPolicy has no native FQDN destination selector; a deployment must instead bind an FQDN-capable CNI extension or a dedicated egress proxy/gateway.

external_primary_evidence.kubernetes: Official Kubernetes NetworkPolicy semantics confirm additive policy behavior and deny-all behavior for selected pods when the network plugin enforces the policy.
external_primary_evidence.cilium: Official Cilium documentation describes DNS interception plus toFQDNs for DNS-derived external destination policy and warns that DNS policy depends on the trusted cluster DNS path.
external_primary_evidence.kata: Upstream GitHub releases/latest returned Kata Containers 4.0.0 on 2026-08-17; current upstream installation documentation recommends runtime-rs and exposes kata-qemu-runtime-rs as an example RuntimeClass.

contract_effect: keeps clayverse-default-deny as the non-functional baseline
forbids broad 0.0.0.0/0, ::/0, unrestricted HTTPS and unrestricted DNS recovery paths
requires exactly one deployment-specific external egress strategy: FQDN-capable CNI policy or dedicated egress proxy boundary
requires exact provider-domain policy bytes/configuration to be receipt-bound rather than guessed permanently in source
requires additive policy inventory, allowed-flow probes, denied-flow probes, DNS re-resolution probes and Tier-2 re-attestation before ingress reopens

execution_evidence.reason: Current admitted Vercel product execution path remains blocked before private-source fetch by missing approved host-side GITHUB_READ_TOKEN; no VPS/self-hosted/production substitute is permitted.

unusual_experiment.reason: No shared immutable request/turn id is exposed and the exact user-message timestamp available to this organ has only minute precision, which is insufficient under GO_EXPERIMENT_ATOMIC_LEASE_PROTOCOL.md.

next_high_information_runtime_step: Provision the approved host-side GITHUB_READ_TOKEN on the retained Vercel Preview controller without forwarding it into Sandbox; rebind the then-current product source exactly once; run the exact isolated OCI closure; then execute the accepted digest under Kata/equivalent and prove the selected CNI/egress strategy enforces default-deny plus only the exact required Clerk/Claude/optional-GLM flows across DNS re-resolution and Tier-2 replacement.
